read.thesis: Eaton's Electrical Americas book-to-bill of 1.3 and a $1 billion capacity build support growth, but margin recovery depends on price/cost that is still temporarily negative and a 65% data-center surge that is only partly converting to 2028-and-beyond deliveries.

capex.quote: we are investing more than $1 billion in capacity expansion and bringing online 2 dozen projects across Electrical Americas

triggers.label: Electrical Americas orders up 41%
triggers.quote: record orders up 41% on a rolling 12-month basis and a book-to-bill increasing to 1.3

triggers.label: $1B capacity build, 24 projects
triggers.quote: we are investing more than $1 billion in capacity expansion and bringing online 2 dozen projects across Electrical Americas
triggers.highlight: investing more than $1 billion in capacity expansion

triggers.label: Price/cost temporarily negative in Americas
triggers.quote: the majority of the margin decline was driven by temporary negative price/cost

triggers.label: FY26 organic growth raised to 11-13%
triggers.quote: we now expect total organic growth to be between 11% and 13%, up 200 basis points at the midpoint
triggers.highlight: up 200 basis points at the midpoint

guidance.quote: we now expect total organic growth to be between 11% and 13%, up 200 basis points at the midpoint
we now expect full year EPS to be between $13.40 and $13.60, $13.50 at the midpoint

guidance.value: H1 to H2 up 450 to 500 basis points
guidance.quote: If you look at H1 versus H2, some of you like to look at it that way. We'll be up 450 to 500 basis points.
we're still committed to our 32% margin by 2030

prior_guidance_check.quote: This strong first half of the year give us confidence to raise our guidance again

red_flags.label: Americas margin down YoY on temporary negative price/cost
red_flags.quote: the majority of the margin decline was driven by temporary negative price/cost

red_flags.label: Data-center backlog conversion mostly 2028+
red_flags.quote: The majority will translate to 2028 and beyond deliveries

evasions.topic: Electrical Americas revenue vs margin bridge
evasions.quote: Perhaps you're still just being a little bit cautious on the ramp in terms of what you gave us here today.
